title: Why Your Brain Gets MORE Creative When You're Tired
hook: Does your brain come alive with ideas late at night?

narration.text: When you are tired, your brain may actually become more creative.
This happens because your brain's 'default mode network' activates.
This network is active when your mind wanders, connecting unrelated ideas.
Fatigue reduces your focus, allowing these unusual connections to form.
It means you are less constrained by typical, logical thought patterns.
So, those sleepy moments can be surprisingly good for problem-solving.
Next time you are tired, try a creative task.
Do you feel more open to new ideas when you are less focused?

description: Ever notice how fresh ideas sometimes hit you when you're exhausted? It is not just you. This video explains how being tired can actually boost your creativity, thanks to your brain's default mode network.
topic: Why you might feel more creative or think differently when you are tired, explaining the default mode network's activity.
